polygon.why: Opaque silhouettes are ~half their 128×128 bboxes and interlock in complementary pairs. Rectangle packing of the bboxes needs a 512² POT sheet; bitmap-mask polygon nesting interlocks the pairs into a 256² POT sheet → 1/4 the VRAM.

note: 8 concave 128² sprites (frame==bbox). BBox occupancy is the headline; opaque coverage is ~half, so polygon-mode packing wins (256² vs 512²).
